review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA #12's algebraic alternative, printed p. 5. It explains the necessary case split and checks candidates explicitly. The official graph on pp. 4–5 confirms the same three intersections.
review.annotationCheck: The key is correct. Necessary relations are not mistaken for sufficient conditions: candidates are checked in the original equation and duplicates removed. The algebraic approach requires no reproduced graph.
